test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Nov, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

To throw caution to the wind

options.text: To do something with care and attention
To give answer with utmost attention
To do something without worrying about risk
To roam here and there aimlessly

solution: The correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"To throw caution to the wind"** means to do something without worrying about the risks or potential negative consequences. (जोखिम के बिना चिंता किए कुछ करना) • **Example:** He decided to throw caution to the wind and invest all his savings in the startup. • In this context, the idiom refers to acting recklessly or daringly, without being overly cautious or prudent. (लापरवाही से कार्य करना) Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: To do something with care and attention** (ध्यान और सावधानी से कुछ करना): This means performing an action carefully and with focus. • **Example:** She prepared the presentation with care and attention to every detail. • **Option 2: To give answer with utmost attention** (पूरी सतर्कता से उत्तर देना): This refers to responding with full concentration and attentiveness. • **Example:** The student gave the answer with utmost attention during the oral exam. • **Option 4: To roam here and there aimlessly** (यहाँ-वहाँ बिना उद्देश्य के घूमना): This means wandering without a specific purpose or direction. • **Example:** The tourists roamed here and there aimlessly in the marketplace. 1b0:Td06, The correct answer is: **Option 4 (scrumptious)**.
